name: find_account
purpose: Look up the household's accounts by name, to resolve what a member meant by "the credit card" or "savings". From v_account_balance only. An account this returns nothing for does not exist: the agent never invents one (ADR 0031), it asks.

text.description: Matched case-insensitively against account names. Null lists every account.

type.description: Narrows to one account type when the question implies it.
